title: Astral Observatory
summary: A purpur and glass observatory on the outer End islands. The Astral Sentinel, the Star Warden and the Star Warden's Core.

s.x: The Astral Observatory is the last dungeon: a purpur and glass observatory on the outer End islands, with star-map murals, telescopes, glass roofs and end rods. You climb through the Lower Halls past the Astral Sentinel, up to the Star Deck, and into the Dome where the
keeps the sky. It is the hardest fight in the game short of the Ender Wyrm, and its boss drops the Star Warden's Core and the Astral Shards that go into the Void Sigils that summon the Wyrm.

The first floor stands on purpur stilts, on the island or over the void, at about y 68. The second floats on a thin hull above it.

The first floor stands on stilts, sometimes over the void, and the End has no safe ground below it. Bring a way to stop a fall (blocks, slow falling) and be careful at the edges.
Three spine stages of halls 17 blocks deep: halls of charts (carpets, star-map murals, cartography tables), archives, glass galleries and sentinel quarters.

Side rooms: a telescope room, a map room, a lens workshop and the astronomer's quarters (with a cache). Small rooms: a closet, a stargazer's nook (a cache) and a guard post.

s.x: At two thirds "the lenses align" and the Warden calls his acolytes. At one third "the dome cracks and starlight pours in".

Expect the Warden at your back every 7 seconds. The black hole drags you towards him, so be ready to leave the 8 block slam ring straight after. Spend your burst when the ward drops, and kill the Mites quickly.
